verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a collaboration platform like Slack, but the pack documents no batch or bulk capability. The Web API, MCP server and Workflow Builder are shown only as per-item actions or as developer building blocks a user could script loops with. Workspace export is a separate data-portability capability, not bulk operations across items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
